## About Mohawk Global

Mohawk Global is a team of supply chain and trade specialists dedicated to fulfilling your supply chain needs with a strong emphasis on customs brokerage, domestic and international transportation, trade compliance, education, and consulting.

Mohawk Global Trade Advisors is our consulting division, which offers expert project support, guidance, and training in supply chain management, import/export trade compliance, C-TPAT, and free trade agreements.

Our vision: By enriching the lives of our people, Mohawk Global is a leader in delivering world class, personalized logistics solutions.
